messages:
maria: Hey team — onboarding Aster-13B-v2. Quick sync: where are the final weights, any tokenizer quirks we should know about, and what does licensing require for hosted vs private? cc @priya @devon @kevin (legal)

devon: Weights are at s3://redwood-models/aster/13b/v2/weights.tar.gz. There's also a public symlink at gs://redwood-public/aster/13b/latest for internal smoke tests. SHA256: 9f2c1a... (will add exact in the manifest). Config lives in infra/models/aster/13b/v2/config.json. Use `redwood-validate model --path infra/models/aster/13b/v2` to pre-check.

priya: Tokenizer notes: it's byte-level BPE with a custom unk token `<|unk_aster|>`. We saw misalignment for leading-space tokenization in some RTL/Indic samples. Recommend loading with HF tokenizers but force `use_fast=False` in the eval harness for now. Example:```python
from transformers import PreTrainedTokenizerFast
tok = PreTrainedTokenizerFast(tokenizer_file='tokenizer.json', unk_token='<|unk_aster|>')
tok.add_special_tokens({'pad_token':'<|pad|>'})
```
Small test case: "\u200ehello" tokenizes differently on v0.13 vs v0.15 — added a unit in tokenizer-tests.

kevin (legal): License scan note: Aster-13B-v2 is released under CC BY-NC 4.0 with an explicit dataset attribution clause. Summary: attribution required in model_card, and commercial hosting (hosted API for paying customers) is NOT permitted without an additional license from the upstream authors. Dedicated/private deployments are ok with our standard enterprise sign-off. Please treat this as a compliance gate.

licensing-bot: Automated license-scan result: CC-BY-NC-4.0 + custom-attribution detected. ACTION: gating required. Suggested enforcement: `hosted=false` in model manifest; show attribution_text in UI; require legal sign-off label `licensing:approved` for any commercial use. See https://internal.redwood/legal/licenses/cc-by-nc for details.

sam: I'll add a pre-ingest check that rejects manifests with `hosted: true` for NC models. Quick Q: do we need a structured `attribution_text` field in the manifest or is a freeform link in model_card enough?

kevin (legal): Please require a structured `attribution_text` field — short sentence + source URL. Example: "Trained on XYZ dataset; see https://dataset.example/terms — credit: XYZ Research Lab." Also include `contact_email` for takedown/DMCA.

maria: Plan: 1) I'll draft model_card.md with the attribution_text and contact_email. 2) Priya will land tokenizer fix & add `use_fast=False` compat in tests. 3) Devon will confirm weights sha and add the gs symlink to the release pipeline. 4) Sam will add gating rule and run `redwood-validate`. Target: EOD tomorrow for draft push.

devon: Ping me for CR when you push the manifest. I'll run the pipeline and verify the symlink.

priya: One more note: in the eval harness, add `tokenizer.pad_token` explicitly before batching — otherwise some metrics drift. I'll include the patch in my branch.

maria: Awesome. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: If legal needs me to change wording in the card I'll update after kevin review.

kevin (legal): I'll review the draft. If we need a tighter hosted restriction we'll flag it. For now the gating/listing rules above should be sufficient.

licensing-bot: Follow-up scan scheduled after manifest update. Reply with `@licensing-bot rescan` once pushed.

maria: Will do.
